properties.name: awskotlin.enabled
properties.description: Whether AWS SDK for Kotlin auto-configuration is enabled.

properties.name: awskotlin.region
properties.description: Override the AWS region. When unset, the SDK default region chain is used.

properties.name: awskotlin.endpoint
properties.description: Override the AWS service endpoint URL (for example, a LocalStack endpoint).

properties.name: awskotlin.access-key-id
properties.description: Static AWS access key ID. Must be configured together with awskotlin.secret-access-key.

properties.name: awskotlin.secret-access-key
properties.description: Static AWS secret access key. Must be configured together with awskotlin.access-key-id.

properties.name: awskotlin.profile-name
properties.description: AWS shared config profile name used to resolve credentials.
